narrative.intro: Frequentis Usa has $298M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Frequentis Usa won 9 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $33.1M. Frequentis Usa obligations are up 90.8% year over year. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Frequentis Usa obligations rose each year from FY23 to FY26, moving from $7.2M in FY23 to $34.3M in FY24, $156M in FY25, and $298M in FY26. Frequentis Usa shows concentration by market: Telephone Apparatus Manufacturing accounts for $283M of FY2026 to date obligations, followed by Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing at $9.6M and Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing at $3.9M. Frequentis Usa also recorded obligations in Engineering Services, Computer Systems Design Services, and Communication Equipment Repair and Maintenance during FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: How large are Frequentis Usa's FY2026 obligations?
sections.body: Frequentis Usa has $298M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Frequentis Usa received 9 awards this fiscal year with an average award size of $33.1M. Frequentis Usa obligations are up 90.8% year over year compared with the prior year-to-date. Frequentis Usa obligations grew from $156M in FY25 to $298M in FY26.

sections.heading: What markets and industries are driving Frequentis Usa's obligations?
sections.body: Telephone Apparatus Manufacturing is the largest market for Frequentis Usa with $283M in FY2026 to date obligations. Frequentis Usa also has obligations in Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing ($9.6M) and Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing ($3.9M). Frequentis Usa recorded smaller obligations in Engineering Services ($662K), Computer Systems Design Services ($100K), and Communication Equipment Repair and Maintenance ($55.2K).
